I just inherited a sub and I'd like to un-anonymize it, but currently it is impossible.

It would be great if it would be possible to de-anonymize it, by maybe having a 10 day cool-down period after you disable anonymized mode. So it would have a big red banner at the top saying "in X days this sub will be de-anonymized" - then when that time is up, all the anonymous posts and comments stay anonymous, but any new posts and comments get posted as normal. This way you don't out any people who posted anonymously.

Also, the current anonymized mode makes a subverse kind of barely usable. It becomes more of like a newspaper site with articles that you can read. You can't tell what's interesting or not. You can't tell which comments are interesting.

If there were multiple ways to anonymize, I think that would be awesome:

  1. Light: All it does is it hides the votes, people can still vote, articles and comments still raise to the top, but it just doesn't show the vote counts. The posts and comments still show up in a persons profile and the upvotes/downvotes affect the persons IKP.

  2. Medium: Hides vote counts and usernames - everything still works as normal, posts/comments raise to the top. The posts and comments still show up in a persons profile and the upvotes/downvotes affect the persons IKP. So instead of creating a number for a persons username, it would just be [hidden]. So you can still access that persons comments from their profile page.

  3. Heavy: How it is now. Anonymized everything, no downvote/upvoting, posts/comments don't show up in a persons profile.
